decisions: No maintained behavior change. Pocock TDD reviewed; no new tests or test seams.
Grill-with-docs reviewed. Explicit autonomy resolves design choices without an interview.
Existing branch_retirement.py supports local backups only. It cannot push archive tags and was not used for mutation.
Archive tags are new annotated refs with noreply tagger metadata, peeled to the exact triage tips. Pushes are atomic, spaced at least two seconds, and deletion batches contain at most ten branches.
Temporary push-time validator checks advertised tips and new-tag absence. The CARR repository hook is chained and its command-specific Git config is isolated from synthetic tests.
The first CARR tag push failed four synthetic hook checks because config leaked into tests. Live refs confirmed no effect before retry. No repository source changed.

A second atomic CARR push passed local checks but GitHub rejected seven lightweight tags with GH007. No tags were created. An annotated-tag probe with noreply tagger succeeded at the original commit; all archives use that form without history rewrites or privacy-setting changes.
The concurrency-guard row cites no PR number. Its landing proof uses merged DoctorCRE PR 143, the integrated timing replacement cited by the adjacent concurrency row.
